title: Cooperativity
description: Haemoglobin's four sites help each other: once one holds oxygen, the rest grab it faster. Its curve is an S, not a bend (Hill).

puzzle.goal: Sites that help each other bind as an S-curve with steepness n. Write the share Y of sites filled at level S, for half-filling at K.
puzzle.name: Hill equation
puzzle.form: S ^ n / ( K ^ n + S ^ n )
puzzle.expr: S ^ n / ( K ^ n + S ^ n )
puzzle.ask: Find Y for S = @{S}, K = @{K} and n = @{n} (about haemoglobin's steepness is 2.8).
puzzle.method: With n sites binding together, filling goes as Sⁿ; at S = K it is exactly half.
